description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of various relational association categories, consisting of 11 distinct slices. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, bolded category labels, along with their corresponding raw counts and percentages enclosed in parentheses, are positioned directly on or adjacent to the outer edge of each slice. Visually, the segments are arranged in ascending order of size in a clockwise direction starting from the top. Proceeding clockwise, the slices are: "NearSameEntity" in dark grey at 63 (6.34%), "RelativePosition" in light grey at 81 (7.90%), "MentalitySimilarity" in light cyan at 89 (8.67%), "SimilarEvent" in light blue at 90 (8.77%), "AppearanceSimilarity" in light green at 90 (8.77%), "Layout" in pale yellow at 90 (8.77%), "Environment" in teal at 90 (8.77%), "UsageSimilarity" in coral at 100 (9.65%), "SubEvent" in pinkish-red at 100 (9.74%), and "SimilarMaterial" in orange at 106 (10.33%). The final and largest slice, colored mint green, features a blurred-out label but displays a value of 126 (12.28%). None of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting, though the grey blurring over the largest slice's label is a notable visual artifact.
